data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Gorgeous Geller Hand-tufted Wool Rug](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a553ae0fa0ab43622353343)

Purchased a wool rug during a 4th of July sale. Shipping was incredibly quick (bought the night of the 8th, was delivered the 11th). There's always a gamble when ordering online that colors aren't adjusted to be true to life, but the rug color was exactly as pictured.

Wish the rug pad ordered along with the rug had made it before the rug itself, but that's just being nitpicky. The rug is thick and plush enough that it really doesn't even need the pad. It flattened out immediately - no annoying corner rolling. It's shedding a bit, but that's to be expected with a new, higher pile wool rug. Love it!

July 8, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 13, 2026

Hi Megan,

We are so glad to hear that you are enjoying your new wool rug, and that the color was exactly as you expected. It's wonderful to know that the shipping was quick, and that the rug flattened out immediately without any corner rolling. We appreciate your positive feedback!

Lulu and Georgia
